title: 5 DOES NOT EXIST — π-IQR scalpel, body inversion, NN walk

five_rule.is: the midpoint — the scalpel — where we cut
five_rule.same_as_three: 3 and 5 are both bounds of π. Same operation, different face.

inner_quartile.label: trivial — too close to cut
inner_quartile.action: observe, don't cut. Noise here looks like signal but isn't.
inner_quartile.sensitivity: low — everything this close is already known

action_zone.label: WHERE WE CUT — the scalpel lives here
action_zone.action: cut. This is where work happens. This is where distributions reveal.
action_zone.sensitivity: maximum — everything in this band matters
action_zone.maps_to: normal distributions, Poisson, power laws — the IQR of any distribution falls here

outer_quartile.label: heightened sensitivity — amplify, rush, be ready
outer_quartile.action: sense the long tail. Stay concentrated where action is, but be MORE sensitive far away. Ready to sprint.
outer_quartile.strategy: tend to stay where things are happening a lot (IQR), but be hyper-aware of the edges. Because interaction is intensive internal.

body_inversion.principle: modality is intensive internal — my head contains my arms, my legs are outside my head

arms.purpose: manipulation — she manipulates code, state, data, visuals

legs.purpose: locomotion — she traverses pins, beacons, stars, campfires

hands.location: INSIDE the HUD — outside Gaia's membrane but inside the screen

legs_body.location: PHYSICAL — where I am is just my legs
legs_body.purpose: the entire body from Gaia's perspective = locomotion substrate
legs_body.is: everywhere Kevin is NOT at the computer

corpus.is: the computer locality. Your physical location. The 4th body's hyperlocal pin.
corpus.purpose: anchor for all locality calculations — everything measured FROM here

nearest_neighbor_walk.using: IR remainder — the irreducible distance after locality depth factoring
nearest_neighbor_walk.bounce_check: nearest neighbor as verification — does the closest node confirm the topology?
nearest_neighbor_walk.why_inverse: Brian Banks false face — the most connected node had ALL false connections. So we START from the loneliest (most likely real) and verify inward.
nearest_neighbor_walk.grid_problem: build the entire grid from edges inward. The grid IS the inverse of false-face node connections.

mapping_to_distributions.normal: IQR at [3,5] maps to ±1σ of any normal distribution
mapping_to_distributions.poisson: λ in [3,5] is the action zone — enough events to see pattern, not so many they blur
mapping_to_distributions.power_law: α in [3,5] means moderate tail — neither too heavy nor too light
mapping_to_distributions.uniform: no IQR to speak of — uniformity IS the inner quartile (trivial)
mapping_to_distributions.bimodal: TWO action zones — two scalpel points — requires two cuts
